notes: The winhttp.dll proxy is used by BepInEx; Localify keeps ownership of version.dll.
The previous 6.0.0-pre.2 loader failed because its LibCpp2IL supported metadata 23-29 while the updated game uses metadata 31.
Runtime verification parsed metadata 31.1 but failed to locate code and metadata registration; BepInEx/interop remained empty and no plugins could load.
Standalone Cpp2IL pre-release.21 with the official StrippedCodeRegSupport plugin reproduced the same registration discovery failure.
The game itself remains playable, but this loader candidate must not be used for the VR implementation.
